assessment: This valuable study demonstrates that the behavior of the cells in the presomitic mesoderm in zebrafish embryos depend on both an intrinsic program and external information, providing new insight into the biology underlying embryo axis segmentation. There is convincing support for the findings with a thorough and quantitative single-cell real-time imaging approach, both in vitro and in vivo, developed by the authors.
